topic_thesis: Your bank is systematically bleeding your savings through 'micro-fee inflation' while you're distracted by their flashy marketing campaigns.
strategic_angle: Expose the 'Death by a Thousand Cuts' strategy: Banks and corporations don't raise prices overnight; they quietly introduce 1-2% convenience fees, GST-on-interest, and AMC hikes that compound into thousands of rupees lost annually.
key_statistic: ₹12,400 average annual loss per retail user through stealth fees and compounding interest charges.
target_emotion: Outrage at being manipulated and a sudden impulse to audit bank statements.
pinned_comment_text: Check your last 3 months of bank statements—how much did they 'conveniently' deduct in hidden fees? Tell us your bank, or comment 'GUIDE' if you want our audit template to catch these leeches. 💬👇
tamil_adaptation_directive: Use a tone of 'Vellai Sattai Villain' (White-collar villain). Use Tanglish phrases like 'Bank manager namba vechi namma pocket-ah kaali panranga' and 'Hidden charges-ah kandu pudinga'. Focus on the 'Middle-class savings' angle.
source_signal: RBI transparency mandates regarding credit card charges and consumer frustration with unsolicited billing.
